title: OpenJLPT Vocabulary Entry
description: A single JLPT vocabulary item at a given level.

id.description: Stable identifier. Assigned once (first 10 hex digits of SHA-1(word + U+0000 + reading) at the time) and then frozen in sources/ids.lock.json, so it never changes even if the word's spelling or reading is corrected. Use it to key user progress.

word.description: Headword as written (kanji, mixed, or kana-only).

reading.description: Kana reading. For kana-only words this equals `word`.

romaji.description: Modified Hepburn romanization of `reading` (lowercase, no macrons: とうきょう → toukyou).

pos.description: Part-of-speech codes from JMdict for the sense that matches `meanings` (e.g. n, v1, v5k, vt, adj-i, adj-na, adv, vs). See data/json/meta.json for descriptions.

jmdict_id.description: JMdict entry sequence number (ent_seq) — links to the full dictionary entry.

other_forms.description: Other accepted spellings (e.g. いい → よい; あさって → 明後日).

other_readings.description: Other accepted readings (e.g. 四 し → よん).

examples.description: Up to two example sentences from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

tatoeba_id.description: Tatoeba ID of the Japanese sentence — https://tatoeba.org/sentences/show/<id> (Tatoeba examples only).
